issue.title: Master CI churn outpaces run completion: no way to observe a green master CI run
issue.description: Master receives a push every 5-10 minutes from many concurrent agents while a full CI run (GitHub Actions on this repo) takes up to ~2 hours. Newer pushes keep cancelling/superseding in-flight runs before they finish, so it is currently impossible in practice to observe a completed, non-cancelled CI run against a still-current master HEAD -- the acceptance signal epics rely on ('confirm a green master CI run') cannot be produced. Discovered while landing epic sase-th (Repair the red master CI lanes) at its land phase sase-th.7: two separate ~1.5h monitor windows polling 'gh run list --repo sase-org/sase --branch master --workflow CI' every 60s never observed a completed non-cancelled run against a still-current HEAD; runs kept getting superseded by the next push every few minutes. The only run that did complete during ~3h of observation (32862277023, sha 9fb3a1805e4) was already stale (many commits behind) by the time it finished, and even then only completed because master briefly slowed down. Same underlying issue independently blocked epic sase-m4 (Stabilize GitHub Actions) at its m4.6 phase, which never reached final acceptance for the identical reason (no green master CI run observed) before being closed with that item unmet.

task_type_fields.impact: Blocks any epic or process that requires observing a green master CI run as an acceptance criterion; forces land agents to substitute local check-full/test-visual plus best-effort attribution of the one stale completed run instead of the real signal.
task_type_fields.location: CI workflow config (.github/workflows/*.yml) and/or master merge/push process in sase-org/sase
task_type_fields.repro: Run: while true; do gh run list --repo sase-org/sase --branch master --workflow CI --limit 1 --json databaseId,headSha,status,conclusion; sleep 60; done for 90+ minutes and observe the headSha changing every few minutes while status never reaches a non-cancelled 'completed' against the latest HEAD.

payload.entry: Resolved by epic sase-um phase sase-um.1: .github/workflows/master-gate.yml (5d8872f4d) is a per-SHA push lane (concurrency group master-gate-${{ github.sha }}, cancel-in-progress: false), so a newer push can no longer cancel an earlier commit's run, and sase-um.3 (840dd3eb4) moved the ~107-minute exhaustive lane off the master push path into the scheduled full.yml. The acceptance signal this bead says cannot be produced now exists: measured 2026-08-28, 47 completed Master Gate runs against 46 master commits in the trailing 24h, with a single cancellation in the last 50 runs (33127407974, a run whose sibling shards were cancelled while test (1) was already failing, not a push supersession). ci_watch reads the gate HEAD-scoped through a gating_workflows allowlist rather than actstat's settled-commit record. Note that master CI green-ness itself is still not durable (Full CI is red on visual-test / test (3.13) / coverage-contexts); that is tracked as remaining sase-um epic work, not as this bead's observability defect.

payload.close_reason: fixed by epic sase-um (Release gate liveness)
